title: KillStats
description: Tracks your entity kills during gameplay sessions and displays live statistics via a configurable in-game HUD overlay.
body:
# KillStats

**Track every kill, estimate your loot, and dominate the battlefield!**

This lightweight client-side Fabric mod tracks your entity kills during gameplay sessions and displays live statistics via a configurable in-game HUD overlay.

## Features

### Kill Tracking
- **Per-mob breakdown** - See exactly how many of each mob type you've killed
- **Multiple kill methods** - Tracks melee, projectile, and splash potion kills
- **40+ mob types** - Covers hostile, passive, nether, end mobs, and bosses

### HUD Display
- **Full mode** - Detailed per-mob breakdown with drop icons and kill counts
- **Compact mode** - Minimal single-line display for less screen clutter
- **Configurable position** - Place the HUD in any corner of the screen
- **Adjustable opacity and scale** - Fine-tune the look to your preference
- **Smart visibility** - Show only when holding weapons, or keep always visible

### Session Management
- **Session timer** - Track how long you've been hunting with start/pause/resume
- **Auto-pause** - Timer pauses automatically when opening menus
- **Session summary** - Detailed breakdown in chat when leaving a world or resetting
- **Persistent sessions** - Optionally save session data across world exits

### Milestones & Alerts
- **Kill milestones** - Chat notifications every X total kills (configurable)
- **Per-mob milestones** - Notifications every 50 kills of the same mob type
- **Boss kill effects** - Gold flash and sound when defeating bosses
- **Sound alerts** - Optional audio feedback on milestones

## Customization

Configure everything in-game via ModMenu:

**HUD Settings**
- HUD position (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right)
- Always visible toggle
- Background opacity (0-100%)
- HUD scale (0.5x-2.0x)

**Keybinds** (Controls > KillStats)
- `K` - Start/Pause/Resume timer
- `L` - Reset session
- `J` - Toggle compact mode

**Session Settings**
- Show session summary on exit
- Auto-pause timer in menus
- Persistent session storage

**Milestones**
- Milestone sound toggle
- Milestone interval (0 = disabled)

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 26.1+
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.18.4 or higher
- **Fabric API**: Required
- **Java**: 25 or higher
- **ModMenu** + **YACL**: Optional (for in-game config screen)

## Perfect For

- **Grinders** - Track your mob farm efficiency with kill counts and drop value estimates
- **Speedrunners** - Monitor kills and session time in a clean overlay
- **Adventurers** - See your combat stats at a glance while exploring
- **Everyone** - Anyone who wants to know their kill stats in Minecraft!
